create_pytorch_dtensor_parallel_backend: create a PytorchDTensorParallelBackend to initialize distributed training with configurable parallel degrees for data, context, tensor, and pipeline parallelism
apply_fsdp2_model: apply FSDP2 to a PyTorch model with mixed precision policy, CPU offload, and per-block resharding configuration
apply_context_parallel: apply context parallel hooks to a model to shard and gather tensors across ranks for long-sequence attention
save_checkpoint_ptd: save a distributed checkpoint of model, optimizer, and dataloader states using PyTorch distributed checkpointing
load_checkpoint_ptd: load a distributed checkpoint from a previous training step restoring model, optimizer, and scheduler states
